analytical_question: What innovation does the proposed application represent, what value could it create or displace, and which business-model judgment is defensible for the specified organization?
general_et_finding: Agentic AI combines LLM reasoning with tool use and feedback [S2]. Its development includes invention, practical innovation and commercial offerings [S3, C1]; these dimensions overlap. Availability is not proof of vendor profitability or market-wide diffusion. The supplied evidence does not establish a universal breakthrough against existing automation. This technology-level conclusion stays unchanged across the cases.

evidence.claim: Innovation requires meaningful difference and implementation; organizational novelty need not be world novelty.
evidence.notes: A specific SPS deployment or a universal breakthrough threshold.

evidence.claim: Separates model-directed tool use from fixed workflows; discusses complexity and compounding errors.
evidence.notes: Independent proof of superiority, reliability or savings at SPS; current tooling completeness.

evidence.claim: Commercial availability of an enterprise agent offering was announced in 2024.
evidence.notes: Verified customer ROI, broad adoption, current price, or SPS procurement.

evidence.claim: Public admissions information and staff appointment channels exist.
evidence.source_or_reference: [S4] NYU School of Professional Studies, Graduate Admissions. https://www.sps.nyu.edu/join/graduate-admissions.html
evidence.notes: Internal CRM, response delays, staff costs, AI deployment, lost applicants, or adoption posture.

evidence.claim: A pre-LLM conversational assistant was tested for pre-enrollment support at Georgia State.
evidence.source_or_reference: [S5] Lindsay C. Page and Hunter Gehlbach, How an Artificially Intelligent Virtual Assistant Helps Students Navigate the Road to College. https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/pdf/10.1177/2332858417749220
evidence.notes: Agentic-LLM superiority, NYU graduate applicant results, or transfer of effect sizes.

evidence.claim: Generated misinformation and human oversight require explicit controls.
evidence.source_or_reference: [S6] NIST, Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile. https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.AI.600-1
evidence.notes: Legal clearance, a guaranteed safe deployment, or quantified business disruption.

evidence.claim: The course separates sustaining/disruptive logic and business exposure by severity and time horizon.
evidence.source_or_reference: [C2] Andres Fortino, ET Creative Destruction FA26 (2).pptx, slides 9 and 24; user-supplied course material.
evidence.notes: Framework only. The numerical planning bins and scenario placements are analytical choices, not observed outcomes.

application_finding: Status: proposed, not verified as implemented. Baseline: counselors plus public information and fixed workflows. The candidate innovation is a connected support process that can select approved information, clarify a question and request an appointment. Local significance is most defensibly incremental and sustaining: it improves the existing applicant relationship while preserving the educational offer. Actual local novelty still requires the internal baseline [S1, C1]. Prior chatbot work [S5] weakens any claim that student outreach itself is unprecedented. A breakthrough claim would require a demonstrated capability beyond simpler automation, not just fluent answers. Model-directed tool choice must be verified before calling the implementation agentic [S2].
organization_specific_finding: Business-Model Disruption Judgment: Moderate, conditional scenario for SPS recruitment-support activities over a 12-month decision horizon; not observed destruction of the institution. Causal path: reliable tool-assisted support could reduce repetitive handling and shift the entry channel toward self-service; this could change support costs and the value of outsourced routine inquiry work. Applicants gain convenience, SPS may gain staff capacity, while platforms may capture fees and new bargaining power. Counselors retain exception handling and relationship work; knowledge stewardship and quality assurance become more valuable. Degrees and teaching are not replaced by this use case. Incumbent tension: avoiding any workflow change protects familiar service practices, but can also delay learning; cutting staff prematurely would put trust at risk. Course matrix [C2]: Moderate / near-term is a provisional investigation scenario if material task change is feasible within 0-12 months, not a verified forecast. The named bins are assignment planning assumptions. No evidence supports a High or Potentially Existential verdict for SPS.
contrary_evidence_or_limitations: The strongest rival is a simpler retrieval/FAQ workflow that meets the same need at lower total cost. Compare both on the same approved support tasks before attributing value to autonomy.

If review and correction absorb the saved time, disruption could be Low. If applicant acquisition channels or an important external intermediary are materially displaced, the Moderate judgment deserves reassessment. No such displacement is currently observed.

No verified low-end or new-market foothold and subsequent move toward incumbent customers is shown. Sustaining process innovation is better supported here than proven Christensen-style disruption [C2].
NYU internal CRM, staff capacity, adoption posture, delays and economics are assumptions. S4 confirms only public-facing channels. S5 concerns another institution and older technology.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence in the conditional mechanism and the sustaining interpretation; low confidence in magnitude, timing and actual organizational novelty. A numeric ROI or enrollment forecast is withheld. Commercial availability does not resolve local suitability.
value_opportunity_implication: Potential value is reliable support capacity. Count any released staff time separately from cash savings: salaries fall only if staffing or purchased services actually change. Enrollment revenue is unproven and must not be inferred from faster replies.
risk_governance_implication: Early adoption risks wrong guidance and unauthorized tool actions; delayed response risks missing a useful support improvement. The evidence supports learning now, not workforce replacement. Keep admission, scholarship, eligibility and visa judgments with authorized people. Privacy, accessibility and permission checks require the appropriate specialists; this is not legal approval.
recommendation_management_implication: Investigate a bounded comparison before any applicant-facing pilot. Use synthetic or approved non-sensitive inquiries and the same success rubric for staff-only, simple retrieval and the proposed agent. Adoption decides go/no-go; Readiness verifies systems and human oversight; Diffusion checks actual peer uptake; Landscape checks current alternatives and supplier dependency; Promethean judges wider barrier dissolution. Preserve the course matrix as a planning aid, not a deployment authorization.
change_monitoring_triggers: Proposed owner: admissions operations with finance. Before a pilot decision, compare cost per correctly completed support task across the three alternatives, including staff review, integration, platform, monitoring and correction. If the agent cannot beat the simpler alternative on cost or useful capability at acceptable quality, lower the value/disruption claim.

Proposed owner: admissions quality lead. Use the same independently reviewed tasks, including outdated deadlines, unsupported eligibility requests and ambiguous program questions. Any consequential wrong guidance or unauthorized action blocks expansion pending correction. This is a proposed gate, not an empirical safety standard.

Proposed owner: enrollment analytics. Over one admissions cycle, examine reliable completion and applicant progression with a credible comparison design; only then consider an enrollment-effect claim. No numeric effect is assumed.

Proposed owner: strategy/procurement. Review quarterly whether verified competitor service changes, supplier terms or channel shifts threaten recruitment advantage; reconsider the rating if the core value-capture path changes.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Need actual workflow, inquiry mix, permissions, integration costs, baseline service quality and review burden.
Withhold implemented-innovation status, quantified ROI, staff-reduction estimates and an unconditional adoption recommendation.
